description:
A backup software for your Mac or Windows PC.


Improvements
- Arq Premium's email report limits now apply to each backup plan instead of to the whole computer, so a report from one backup plan no longer holds back a report from another.
- The Edit Backup Plan window now explains Arq Premium's email report limits when Arq Premium sends the reports, with a "Learn More..." link to the help.
Bug Fixes
- Arq Pro: Fixed a computer no longer syncing with Arq Pro after a failed license refresh (for example, because of a network error) until a later refresh succeeded or the Arq7Agent service restarted.
